map.下料长度 = 外包尺寸之和 − 量度差值 + 弯钩增加长度: Cut length = sum of outside dimensions − measurement deduction + hook addition

map.梁柱纵筋与箍筋翻样：外包尺寸减去 90°/135° 弯曲调整值，加弯钩增量，得到: Bar bending schedule for longitudinal and stirrup reinforcement: outside dimensions minus the 90°/135° bend adjustment, plus the hook increment, gives the actual cut length.
map.弯折钢筋（如雨棚、悬挑）：按弯曲直径 D 与钢筋直径 d 查弯曲调整值，避免成型: Bent bars such as canopies and cantilevers: look up the bend adjustment from the bend diameter D and bar diameter d so the finished piece is not too short.
map.批量下料优化：按定尺长度 9/12m 套裁，减少接头与废料。: Batch cutting optimisation: nest the stock lengths of 9 m and 12 m to reduce joints and offcuts.

map.直段外包 3000mm，端部 90°弯钩（D=5d，d=20mm）：弯曲调整值≈: For a 3000 mm straight outside dimension with a 90° hook at the end (D = 5d, d = 20 mm): the bend adjustment ≈ 2 × the outer-skin increment, so a single bend deducts about 2.3d ≈ 46 mm. Adding the hook growth gives a net cut length ≈ 3000 − 46 + hook increment, taken from the bar bending schedule table.

map.长了浪费、节点冲突；短了锚固不足影响受力，故翻样须按保护层、搭接、锚固综合取定，: Too long wastes steel and clashes at the joint; too short gives insufficient anchorage and weakens the member. Bar bending schedules must balance cover, laps and anchorage, and leave an allowance for measurement tolerance.
map.量度差值 Δ = 2×(D/2 + d)×tan(α/2) − α_rad×(D: Bend deduction Δ = 2×(D/2 + d)×tan(alpha/2) − alpha_rad×(D + d)/2, i.e. the outer dimension minus the developed centerline length; for alpha > 90 it is split into a 90 bend plus an (alpha-90) bend
map.由弯曲处外皮拉伸、内皮压缩的几何差得出，与弯心直径 D 和 d 有关（如 D=5: It follows from the geometric difference between the stretched outer face and the compressed inner face at the bend, and depends on the mandrel diameter D and the bar diameter d (for example about 2.3d at 90° and about 2.8d at 135° when D = 5d; obtuse angles are split into 90° + (α−90°), and 3d is a common rule of thumb); take the values from 16G101 or the manufacturer tables.
